default_configuration.why: Searching before the model put the answer in the caller's ear 2-3 s sooner than the search tool at p50 (voice runs every-turn-silence-0.30 and tool-silence-0.30) and passed as many conversation evals (21 and 23 of 32 against 21 and 23); the final eval run on this configuration passed 24 of 32. A 0.3 s silence wait cut the typical end-of-turn delay by 0.1-0.3 s against 0.55/0.5 s with no early cut-off on eight utterances with 0.7-1.7 s pauses.

notes: Each voice run asks 20 distinct questions per language, one LiveKit room per language, through LiveKit Cloud; the agent worker, VAD and ONNX embedder run on this Mac.

end_to_end and its stages are measured by the agent (LiveKit metrics, from the caller's last speech to the agent's first audio leaving the worker); end_of_turn_delay includes transcription_delay. llm_time_to_first_token is LiveKit's llm_node first token minus reply_filter_hold, so in every_turn mode it includes the knowledge search.

caller_heard_first_audio and caller_heard_answer are measured by the bench caller, from the end of its utterance to audible agent audio, so they add both network legs and audio buffering. In tool mode the first audio is the acknowledgement and the answer comes after the tool round trip.

Turns the agent never answered are excluded from the percentiles and counted in answered: in every run the ElevenLabs realtime STT websocket was closed by the server 8-13 times (no error message) and the turns spoken during a reconnect were not transcribed.

A cut-off is agent audio while the caller is still speaking; the one in tool-silence-0.30 is the late reply to the previous unanswered turn. A turn committed before the STT's last words arrive is not counted, because LiveKit logs it only once per process.

text_mode runs time the same questions through the agent and Claude without voice; they were run before the every_turn fixes (neutral note on a miss, no search after tool calls or on read-back answers), which do not change the path these knowledge questions take.
